item.title: Amid Conflicting Messages From Trump and Iran, Hopes for Peace Deal Emerge
item.summary: On a day when both Iran and the United States declared the Strait of Hormuz opened, hopes for an agreement rose. But statements from President Trump and Iranian leaders about negotiations were sometimes at odds.

item.title: The U.S. military blockade on ships entering or leaving Iran will continue until Trump ends it.
Trump Is Urged to Act on Iranian Site Feared Impervious to Airstrikes
item.summary: Little is known about Pickaxe Mountain, but some experts say it illustrates the impossibility of relying on force alone to prevent Iran from acquiring a nuclear bomb.

item.title: U.K. Police Investigate Claims Drones Targeted Israeli Embassy in London
item.summary: The Metropolitan Police said that the building had not been attacked but that they were assessing “discarded items” in Kensington Gardens, a nearby park, which was cordoned off.

item.title: In northern Israel, relief at the cease-fire is overshadowed by unease.
item.summary: Residents are wary that the truce may offer only a temporary reprieve after weeks of rocket fire by Hezbollah.

item.title: Iran Resisted a Powerful Attacker. Taiwan Can Too.
item.summary: By holding off America’s more powerful military, Iran showed how Taiwan can deter or defeat China.

item.title: Why Lebanon’s Government Has Struggled to Contain Hezbollah
item.summary: Lebanon’s government has been caught between Western demands to disarm the Shiite Muslim militant group and fears of inflaming sectarian tensions.

item.title: 10-Day Cease-Fire Between Israel and Lebanon Goes Into Effect
item.summary: The pause in the fighting between Israeli forces and Iranian-allied Hezbollah militants may help smooth the way to a peace deal between the U.S. and Iran.
